title: Maps-validated pool-service front-end partnership
one_liner: Confirm 30+ pool (or similar) companies with 100+ reviews via Maps, partner with one strong operator / weak marketer; own SEO/ads/automation only; optimize for phone calls with real job photos.
why_agent_runnable: Maps density scoring, operator shortlists, creative/SEO drafts, call attribution, and partner reporting are agent-native. Brandon picks partner and gates money/hire/publish/send.

ops_steps.title: Maps demand gate
ops_steps.detail: Search pool service (or Brandon-approved alternate) in target metros; log companies with 100+ reviews; confirm 30+ density = demand exists.

ops_steps.title: Operator shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Score operators: strong reviews/work signals, weak website/ads/GBP; draft partnership fit memo.

ops_steps.title: Brandon partner + geo pick
ops_steps.detail: Pick one metro + one operator; approve outreach identity.

ops_steps.title: Partnership + front-end pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft rev-share/retainer terms + SEO pages, call-optimized ads with real job photo briefs, follow-up sequences — legal review Brandon.

ops_steps.title: Publish + ads spend gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve go-live, call tracking, and ad budget on partner or shared brand.

ops_steps.title: Call→job ops loop
ops_steps.detail: Attribute calls to booked jobs; weekly partner report drafts (send gate); propose creative/bid tweaks.

ops_steps.title: Scale geo or kill
ops_steps.detail: Propose next pool geo or adjacent trade; kill if CAC vs booked-job economics fail.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.rev_share_or_retainer: retainer $1k-5k/mo and/or rev-share on booked pool jobs (negotiated)
unit_economics_sketch.maps_demand_gate: 30+ companies with 100+ reviews in metro before partnering
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: No truck/wrench; margin = ad efficiency × partner close rate. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: Maps density scan for 2-3 metros (pool service)
Day 3: operator shortlist with weak-marketing evidence
Day 5-6: partnership memo + call-ad creative drafts
Day 7: Brandon send gate for partner outreach
kill_criteria: No metro clears 30+/100+ review demand gate
No willing operator after 15 Brandon-approved outreaches
Partner close rate too low to hit agreed CAC after 30 days ads
Partner refuses call tracking / job attribution
Brandon declines further ad spend or partnership terms
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
